headline: Pensioners Demonstrate in Madrid Over State System Sustainability Ahead of Elections
summary: Thousands rallied in central Madrid to advocate for public pension protections and indexation, one month before early general elections in Spain.
why: Public pension liabilities form one of the largest expenditure items across European sovereigns, influencing fiscal stability and budget planning.

impacts.name: Spain
impacts.why: Political pressure over entitlement expenditures limits government room for long-term fiscal consolidation.
